sourceProject.measurementMethod: Opened original .blend in background Blender5.2.2. Enabled source collection for dependency evaluation without saving, then measured transformed mesh bounding corners. Saved dormant object matrices before evaluation are not reliable bounds.

sourceVisual: Five-point orange starfish, with ten small pale yellow surface spots. The original four native facings retain distinct orientation on the registered square grid.
The star body is a sharply pointed open triangular fan with one raised center, not a soft organic volume. At logical use size its orange reads nearly flat and its spots read as tiny angular chips.

The target usefully adds plump rounded arm contours, a raised coherent center and tapered arm ridges, warm orange/coral midtone separation and creamy rounded nodule detail. These are design outcomes, not a required vertex construction or spot count.

The target has some highly polished point highlights and outer bright edge traces. Native output should use controlled soft material reflections and clean alpha edges, without copying external halo, rim speckles or inflated target registration.

sourceTechnical.heightInterpretation: Declared0.2 is a low decoration envelope. Actual source thickness is0.1 at z0.07..0.17. Do not scale the model to0.2 thickness or treat the old open fan/raised lower boundary as immutable. Native closure and rounded construction within z0..0.2 are allowed.
